A beautifully illuminated Qur'an open on a wooden stand (Rihal), next to an old-fashioned inkwell and a bamboo pen (Qalam), symbolising the Qur'anic command "Who teacheth by the pen". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A composite illustration of Muslim polymaths' contributions. Left: An open medical text showing anatomy (Ibn Sina). Centre: An astrolabe and a set of balanced scales representing logic and law (Ibn Rushd). Right: A scroll depicting the rise and fall of city walls, symbolising social cohesion (Ibn Khaldun).

A map of West Africa overlaid with the iconic mud-brick architecture of the Sankore Mosque in Timbuktu. Icons point to Kano (associating it with Al-Maghili) and Sokoto (associating it with Usman Danfodio). Clean flat textbook style, warm earthy colours, white background.
